title: Rani Abbakka
subject: English
summary: “Rani Abbakka” is an inspiring chapter about the brave queen of Ullal in Karnataka. She was one of the first Indian rulers to fight against the Portuguese. She was courageous, intelligent and a great leader who loved her country. The Portuguese wanted to capture her kingdom, but Rani Abbakka strongly opposed them and fought bravely to protect her people and land. She used her intelligence and courage to defeat the enemies many times. Even during difficult situations, she never gave up. Rani Abbakka is remembered for her bravery, patriotism and leadership. The chapter teaches us that we should be fearless, courageous and ready to protect our country.
